subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should this be fixed now as an active-work/admission guard in cron/session cleanup, or folded into the broader cron retention and session-storage migration work?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the safest owner boundary crosses cron retention, session lifecycle admissions, and the broader storage migration plan, so maintainers should choose the durable repair path before spawning duplicate automation.

options.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
options.body: Repair the cleanup/reaper path so active admitted cron runs cannot be archived while running, and leave broader key-shape/storage cleanup to existing trackers.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Trackers
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the cron retention and SQLite storage tracks, accepting that the active-run failure remains open until that larger work lands.

options.title: Temporarily Avoid Ambiguous Pruning
options.body: Disable or relax cleanup for ambiguous cron run entries until lifecycle ownership is made explicit, reducing immediate risk at the cost of retained stale state.

recommendation.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
recommendation.body: Repair the cleanup/reaper path so active admitted cron runs cannot be archived while running, and leave broader key-shape/storage cleanup to existing trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent session cleanup lifecycle seam and the broader storage migration coordination that this fix must not fight.
